result.title: Frame geometry, fascicle extrapolation and leaderboard overfitting in muscle ultrasound
result.comment: 38 pages (20 main text, 18 supplement), 13 figures, 21 tables. Code, trained weights, notebooks and derived data are public on Kaggle (user soheilkooklan) and in the ancillary files
result.summary: Automated readings of pennation angle, fascicle length and muscle thickness from B-mode ultrasound depend on the geometry of the stored frame and on how fascicles that leave the image are extended, and challenge entries add settings chosen on a small public leaderboard. This study measures all three in one entry of the UMUD Challenge, which scored 309 frames from six screen layouts, 103 on a public and 206 on a private leaderboard. The pipeline applies layout-specific values of scale and pixel aspect, resamples each frame to square pixels, segments aponeuroses and fascicle fragments with U-Nets and measures the three readings geometrically; the submitted entry blended its angle and length with public notebooks. Because the score is additive, 65 single-change contrasts from 13 base entries measured each decision on both splits. The primary selected entry scored 0.27608 on the private split, the 69th reported position of 690 teams. Reading every frame with square pixels cost 0.029 public and 0.037 private. Of 20 late-stage corrections, 9 kept the sign of their effect on the private split. An audit of the UMUD expert benchmark found that 26 of its 35 frames share their tissue with training images of both DL_Track_US and the challenge. On the 9 frames with no detected match in either set or orientation, the recipe scored 0.213, two experts against two others 0.218 and DL_Track_US 0.263 (0.209, 0.196 and 0.259 when both raters of a reference pair are required), with no difference established. Frame geometry and the extension rule moved readings as much as the choice of model, and small corrections tuned on about 100 public frames did not carry over.

AI.brief_summary: 该研究以一个 UMUD 挑战赛参赛方案为例，量化帧几何、筋膜延伸规则与在约 100 帧公开榜上调参对肌肉超声三项读数的影响，并通过 13 个基线、65 组单变量对比在公开与私有划分上核查各决策是否迁移，同时审计专家基准的图像重叠。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「小公开榜调参的修正不迁移」与基准泄漏审计的定量做法，可能为 LVR 中在小验证集上选择 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等设计及检查评测污染提供评价层面的参考，可供核查。
